But `packages/ui/index.tsx` in this diff now re-exports `MultiEmail` via `./form/MultiEmailLazy`, which dynamically imports `./MultiEmail`. That creates a circular dependency chain: `index.tsx -> MultiEmailLazy -> MultiEmail -> @calcom/ui (index.tsx)`. This is directly shown in the diff and can cause runtime/bundler issues due to circular module evaluation.
